title: Short Cumulative English Review
subtitle: A concise review of the grammar and vocabulary covered so far.
lessonNotes: All four days use familiar material. No new grammar is introduced.

sections.label: Day 1
sections.title: Personal Information and Daily Routines
sections.description: Familiar retrieval practice with forms, occupations, present simple, possessives, articles and adverbs of frequency.

sections.label: Day 2
sections.title: Home, Place and Free-Time Choices
sections.description: Familiar retrieval practice with rooms, furniture, there is/are, demonstratives, place phrases and interests.

sections.label: Day 3
sections.title: Food, Restaurants and Quantities
sections.description: Familiar retrieval practice with food, restaurant language, determiners and quantifiers.

sections.label: Day 4
sections.title: Short Cumulative Grammar Review
sections.description: Mixed retrieval practice with previously covered tenses, future forms, modals, articles, quantifiers, conditionals, infinitives and adverbs.
